_comment: Static reference data for each cruise line's price-drop / price-protection policy. Sourced from https://cruisesignal.app/coverage. Phone numbers verified 2026-09-08 against each line's own contact page / cross-referenced consumer-service directories. Used by the scraper (to decide whether a detected price drop is currently claimable) and by the Android app's Claims and Alerts screens. Update when a cruise line changes its policy or phone number.

lines.monitoring: Public fares matching ship, sail date, and stateroom category. Royal Caribbean-owned booking channels only.

policies.name: 24-Hour Upgrade Window
policies.notes: Applies only in the 24 hours immediately after making a payment.

exclusions: Non-refundable fares only match to other non-refundable prices
lines.eligibility: U.S. and Canadian residents only; must be same currency.
lines.claimChannel: Filed by the customer directly through Royal Caribbean.
howToClaim: Have ready: your reservation number, ship name, sail date, cabin category, and the new lower price (this app shows it on the Alert).
Call Royal Caribbean at 1-866-562-7625 — or contact your travel agent first if you booked through one.
Say: "I'd like to request the Best Price Guarantee on my reservation — I found a lower publicly advertised price for the same ship, sail date, and cabin category."
Give them your reservation number and the new price when asked.
If it's within 24 hours of a payment you just made, ask about the 24-Hour Upgrade Window instead — you may be able to upgrade cabins for the difference rather than get cash/OBC back.
This must be done before your final payment date. Once approved, you'll get a refund or onboard credit — ask which one applies to your booking.

lines.monitoring: Public Carnival pricing across two separate guarantee programs.

policies.name: Early Saver
policies.notes: Refund or onboard credit, valid up to 2 business days before sailing.

policies.name: 110% Lowest Price Guarantee
policies.notes: Non-refundable OBC equal to 110% of the difference, valid 48 hours post-booking.

exclusions: Not offered on Carnival Australia sailings
lines.claimChannel: Filed by the customer directly through Carnival.
howToClaim: Have ready: your booking number, ship name, sail date, cabin category, and the new lower price.
Call Carnival Guest Care at 1-800-764-7419 — or your travel agent if you booked through one.
If you're more than 2 business days from sailing: ask for "Early Saver price protection" — you'll get a refund or onboard credit for the difference.
If it's within 48 hours of when you booked: ask about the "110% Lowest Price Guarantee" instead — a non-refundable onboard credit worth 110% of the difference.
Have the new price ready to reference — they'll check it against Carnival's own current public pricing.

Note: this doesn't apply to Super Saver, Fun Saver, Pack & Go, or Flash Sale fares, group/travel-agent rates, or Carnival Australia sailings — if your fare type was one of these, the rep will tell you it doesn't qualify.

policies.name: Better Than Best Price Guarantee
policies.outcomeDetail: 120% of the difference, capped at US$2,000 onboard credit. Non-refundable, expires at end of cruise.
policies.notes: Before final payment only; bundle matching required.

lines.eligibility: U.S./Canadian residents in matching currency; Princess.com bookings only.
lines.claimChannel: Filed by the customer before the final payment deadline.
howToClaim: Have ready: your booking number, ship name, sail date, cabin category, your fare bundle (Princess Plus or Princess Standard), and the new lower price you found on princess.com.
Call Princess at 1-800-774-6237 — or your travel agent if you booked through one — before your final payment date.
Ask for the "Better Than Best Price Guarantee."
The new price must be on princess.com itself (not a travel agency or OTA site) and for the same bundle (Plus vs. Standard) as your booking.
If approved, you'll get onboard credit equal to 120% of the difference, capped at $2,000 — it's non-refundable and expires at the end of your cruise, so plan to actually use it onboard.

policies.name: Repricing
policies.notes: Fare is repriced down to the new lower public fare.

policies.name: 48-Hour OBC
policies.outcomeDetail: 100% of the difference as onboard credit. Forfeited at 10 PM on the last night of the cruise.
policies.notes: Applies in the 48 hours after final payment.

policies.name: UK/Non-US-Canada 10% Program
policies.notes: Separate, more limited program for UK and other non-US/Canada residents.

lines.eligibility: US/Canada residents get full program; UK and other residents limited to the 10% program.
lines.claimChannel: Filed by the customer directly through Celebrity.
howToClaim: Have ready: your reservation number, ship name, sail date, cabin category, and the new lower price.
Call Celebrity at 1-800-647-2251 — or your travel agent if you booked through one.
Before or at your final payment date: ask them to "reprice" your reservation to the new lower public fare.
If you're within 48 hours after your final payment: ask about the "48-Hour OBC" program instead — 100% of the difference as onboard credit.
If you're outside the US/Canada (e.g. UK): ask about the separate 10% program, which is more limited.
OBC from the 48-hour program is forfeited at 10 PM on the last night of the cruise, so use it before then.

lines.monitoring: Public fares on matching itinerary elements. Regional variation applies.

policies.name: Regional Price Protection
policies.notes: No guaranteed remedy; programs differ by region, booking channel, and fare type.

lines.eligibility: Varies by region and booking channel.
lines.claimChannel: Filed by the customer; timing windows vary by applicable program.
howToClaim: Have ready: your booking number, ship name, sail date, cabin category, and the new lower price.
Call Norwegian at 1-866-234-7350 — or your travel agent if you booked through one.
Ask what price-protection options apply to your specific booking — NCL's policy varies by region, booking channel, and fare type, so there's no single guaranteed remedy to ask for by name.
Mention the new price you found and ask them to check it against the same ship, sail date, and cabin category.
Group fares, partner-rate fares, restricted promotional fares, and stateroom guarantees are typically excluded — if your fare type was one of these, expect the rep to say it doesn't qualify.
